title: Handoff: everything learned while Claude Code worked on Anvil (to continue in Antigravity)
why: The user is switching to Antigravity for a while. This records the working rules, the gotchas and the open follow-ups so that work continues without relearning them.
where: Repository-wide; key places: crates/anvil-core/src/review_gate*, crates/anvil-ast/src/rules/*, crates/anvil-cli/slop_bench, crates/anvil-cli/src/commands/hook/{roles,roles_shell,gates,executors}.rs, templates/agents/*
learned:
Working rules (from the user):
- Reply to the user in Spanish; code, commits and README stay in English.
- Commit by topic, in the repo's conventional format (feat/fix/test/ci/style/chore(harness)), with no AI attribution.
- Commit or push only when asked.
- Never bypass hooks (--no-verify is blocked).
- Destructive git operations need the user's OK.
- While orchestrator mode is on, the main thread never edits code, and only the user turns the mode off.
- Quality findings must be precise and blocking, never advisory WARNs; calibrate every new rule on real code and in the slop benchmark before shipping.
- The user trusts the orchestrator and rejected a separate reviewer agent (about 20k tokens per review).

Gotchas:
- clippy too_many_lines is 60, so formatting can push functions over it; split by extracting phases or table-driven constants.
- The test-tampering rule counts assert_ok( calls: moving them into a helper reads as removed assertions, so move blocks verbatim instead.
- Anything under tests/ counts as a test file, so data fixtures such as .case files live outside tests/.
- Escape hatches are reported under the single id no-escape-hatches.
- anvil-allow needs `anvil-allow(<rule>): <reason> [<ref>]` inside a real comment, on the flagged line or the line above.
- Tier 0 reports every finding in a changed file except NEW_CODE_ONLY_RULES.
- review_files leaves out files edited before task_start, so start the task before the first edit.
- Install the binary by renaming the running ~/.cargo/bin/anvil.exe and copying target/release/anvil.exe; run anvil sync afterwards to refresh agent templates.
- Claude Code hot-reloads new agent files, but edits to an existing agent file may not reload in a running session.
- Plugin MCP tools are named mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__*; MCP servers that the desktop app injects are in no config file.
- tree-sitter-dart puts handler blocks directly under try_statement.

Open follow-ups:
- crates/anvil-cli/src/daemon/server.rs:98 `Err(_) => {}` swallows accept() errors (real finding, not fixed).
- Benchmark known gaps: no-commented-out-code, TS console.log debug leftovers (no-debug-helpers exists only for PHP), and a catch emptied by deleting its only statement.
- Extend the benchmark to Kotlin, Dart and GDScript, and turn real review_log findings into cases.
